crossRefs.note: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear Yahweh, and entreat the favor of Yahweh, and…
Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly…
David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks to harm you?’
He said, “Why does my lord pursue his servant? For what have I done? What evil is in my hand?
Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not hurt me; because as before him innocence…
Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”
In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I…
For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don’t refuse to die; but if none of those…
But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and as he himself appealed to the emperor I determined…
When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”
So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Zedekiah
people.line: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

translations.web: Moreover Jeremiah said to king Zedekiah, “How have I sinned against you, against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?
translations.bsb: Then Jeremiah asked King Zedekiah, “How have I sinned against you or your servants or these people, that you have put me in prison?
translations.kjv: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against thee, or against thy servants, or against this people, that ye have put me in prison?
translations.asv: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, Wherein have I sinned against thee, or against thy servants, or against this people, that ye have put me in prison?
